**Severity:** error · **Area:** Slots (`RV6xxx`) · **Quick fix:** none

## Message

The diagnostic reads one of:

```text
<slot> must be used inside a component function
```

```text
<slot> needs the component's props parameter: function {component}(props) or function {component}({ {name} })
```

```text
<slot r:name="{name}">: add `{name}` to the destructured props of {component}
```

Parts in braces (`{name}`) are filled in for each report.

## How to fix

Use `<slot>` inside a component that takes props: function `Card(props)` `{ return <div><slot /></div>; }` (or destructure the slot name).

## Example

```tsx avoid nocheck
export const A = () => <slot />;
```

```tsx prefer
export function A(props: { children?: any }) { return <div><slot /></div>; }
```
